name: compound-v
description: Compound V, Grugg, Oh, Cartographer and brandkit plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: compound-v
plugins.description: Next-project pick, plan format, interrogation of open decisions, plan review, code review with light and instructions passes, follow-up rounds, the review loop, pull requests and releases.

plugins.name: grugg
plugins.description: Terse communication mode and formatters, opt-in.

plugins.name: cartographer
plugins.description: Multi-repo system map over MCP: callers, impact, schema, cross-repo links. Uses the cartographer binary on PATH, or fetches it with mise.

plugins.name: brandkit
plugins.description: Brand and design skills on brandkit packages (DTCG brand tokens; UI as three checked mockups, a pick, a build and a screenshot review), plus an edit-time brand lint hook. Uses the brandkit binary on PATH, or finds it with mise. Claude Code only for now.

plugins.name: oh
plugins.description: Sherman's working agreements: mise first, pull requests as releases, version bumps, questions and plans on the Sugarhouse board, a rough-edge log, a process and secrets guard (one specific kill at a time, no printing secret files), reviewer choices; release, waxseal, mise, Dockerfile and Mapleset design skills.

plugins.name: oh-phoenix
plugins.description: Phoenix, LiveView, Ecto and DaisyUI patterns and references.

plugins.name: oh-tekmetric
plugins.description: Tekmetric REST API: auth, pagination, sync patterns, undocumented behaviour.

plugins.name: oh-telnyx
plugins.description: Telnyx Voice API v2 call control: calls, recording, webhook events.

plugins.name: oh-postmark
plugins.description: Postmark API: transactional and batch email, attachments.

plugins.name: oh-groq
